verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Chat as a native product alongside planning tools like Sprints. A community user independently confirms that ClickUp has real-time chat, and the docs reference Chat views (API comments, Figma embeds in Chat), so team chat lives in the same tool used to plan work. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of chat capabilities (channels, DMs, threads), and evidence of how chat links to tasks and sprints in practice.
